outcome: Acetaminophen level in cord blood at delivery
cohort: 105 pregnant patients undergoing scheduled cesarean delivery (51 received intravenous acetaminophen, 54 received placebo)
finding: Preoperative intravenous acetaminophen did not significantly reduce postoperative opioid use, length of stay, or pain scores in women undergoing cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Preoperative intravenous acetaminophen did not decrease opioid use or length of stay after cesarean delivery.
